name: SKF India Ltd
title: SKF India Ltd - 500472 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Post-demerger SKF India auto margins guided to 11-12% PBT (vs ~20% FY25 cited by analysts), with FY26 sales +12.8% but PBT down 694bp, capex ~INR 500cr over FY26-28 and industrial trading filling capacity gaps.

capex.quote: from '26 to '28, we have around INR 500 crores investment, which will go through each year. This year, '26, will be around INR 200 crores.

triggers.label: PBT margin guided 11-12% near term
triggers.quote: we could be looking at 11-12% kind of margin in the near future

triggers.label: Capex ~INR 500cr over FY26-28
triggers.quote: from '26 to '28, we have around INR 500 crores investment

triggers.label: Net working capital up 4.6% QoQ
triggers.quote: It increased by about 4.6% due to one -off factors

triggers.label: Aftermarket price hikes started
triggers.quote: yes, it is started, that I can give you

guidance.quote: we could be looking at 11-12% kind of margin in the near future
you can consider around 6% to 8% CAGR

guidance.value: INR 500 crore total; ~INR 200 crore in FY26
guidance.quote: from '26 to '28, we have around INR 500 crores investment

red_flags.label: Margin reset post-demerger; disclosure gap
red_flags.quote: the investor communication and the disclosures have dropped substantially

red_flags.label: Trading from affiliate to fill capacity
red_flags.quote: we are short of little capacity. So, we are buying from Industrial

red_flags.label: Related-party rent and service charges unquantified
red_flags.quote: No as of now. We don't have that exactly

evasions.quote: We don't comment on the sub-segments per se
No as of now. We don't have that exactly and this whole case started from last October, so it is too early
Everything is true, what we said. It's maybe a matter of time.
